documents.title: Time of Midterm and No Tutorial for that Day
documents.text:
We have noticed that many midterm exams are arranged on weekends. To avoid conflicts, the CSC1001 Midterm is scheduled for Nov. 1 (Friday) from 19:00 to 21:00.
As a result, tutorials (T13/T14) on Nov. 1 are canceled. If you are in T13/T14, you may attend any tutorial section that week or study independently using the provided slides and codes.
Further details regarding the Midterm arrangements (e.g., locations, permitted materials, etc.) will be communicated in the coming days.
Thanks.

documents.title: Important Update of Midterm Date and Time
documents.text:
In response to the numerous concerns raised about the scheduling conflict with the MAT tutorial on Nov. 1, we have made adjustments to the Midterm Time. The midterm will now take place on Nov. 10 (Sunday) from 19:00 to 21:00.
Please note that there will be no make-up for midterm. Since we notice the midterm date about three weeks earlier, it is imperative that all students attend on time. 
Should you encounter any urgent issues preventing your attendance on that day and can provide proof, kindly reach out to me personally.
Additionally, as we rearranged the midterm, the original Tutorial on Nov. 1 will still be held on time.
The details including location and other information will be communicated in the next few days.
Thanks for your understanding.

documents.title: Further Clarification for Assignment 1
documents.text:
Due to persistent confusion regarding how to define a function in Questions 4 and 5 of Assignment 1, we are providing further clarification:
1. As explicitly stated in Assignment 1, there is no requirement to prompt the user for input or display the final result. Your task is to define a function where the order and format of input parameters and returned results match the example provided. During the grading process, we will supply input following the same order as outlined in the question example and verify the accuracy of the returned results. Before submitting your assignment, it is advisable to test your function using the provided test examples or define additional test cases.
2. In Question 5, the notation "1.5, 0.6" just means the return of two values, which should be a tuple (1.5, 0.6), as the normal situation when a function returns multiple values.

documents.title: Midterm Details
documents.text:
Below are the midterm details:
1. Time: The midterm exam for CSC1001 will be held from 19:00 - 21:00 (Beijing Time) on Nov. 10. 
2. Permitted Materials: You can bring a page of A4 cheating paper (double-sided, printed or hand-written), an ordinary calculator without programming functions, and a paper dictionary for the mid-term exam. NO OTHER MATERIALS PERMITTED. We will provide draft papers during the exam.
3. Range and question type: Lecture1 - Lecture5. There will be 8~12 fill-in-the-blank questions, 4~6 short-answer questions, 2~3 coding questions.
4. Exam place: We will upload a name list showing your exam classroom and seat number before Nov. 8. Please don't go to the wrong classroom during the exam.
5. Absent application: If you cannot attend the exam by accident near the exam days, please contact me through email as soon as possible.

documents.text:

documents.title: Midterm Details
documents.text:
Below are the midterm details:
1. Time: The midterm exam for CSC1001 will be held from 19:00 - 21:00 (Beijing Time) on Nov. 10. 
2. Permitted Materials: You can bring a page of A4 cheating paper (double-sided, printed or hand-written), an ordinary calculator without programming functions, and a paper dictionary for the mid-term exam. NO OTHER MATERIALS PERMITTED. We will provide draft papers during the exam.
3. Range and question type: Lecture1 - Lecture5. There will be 8~12 fill-in-the-blank questions, 4~6 short-answer questions, 2~3 coding questions.
4. Exam place: We will upload a name list showing your exam classroom and seat number before Nov. 8. Please don't go to the wrong classroom during the exam.
5. Absent application: If you cannot attend the exam by accident near the exam days, please contact me through email as soon as possible.
